meta.repo: Ad Astra worktree (local; not a git repository)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (body). Carries ink, ink-2, ink-3, accent-ink text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised grounds: header, footer, panels, tables, filter bar, callouts. Same text tokens as bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed grounds: table heads, code, citation blocks, held-state chips. ink-3 on it is the lowest-contrast text pair (4.89:1 light, 5.76:1 dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between regions and around panels, tables, callouts. Structure is drawn with rules, never shadows.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised hairlines: the page-head ruler ticks, badge and chip outlines, input borders, dashed empty-state border.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Faint internal lines: table row separators, stat-line cell dividers, the empty-state graph-paper grid.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-sunk (16.0:1 / 15.5:1 on bg). Also the pressed-chip fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, summaries, nav links, entry facts (7.9:1 light, 9.7:1 dark on bg).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: kickers, labels, dt terms, counts, 'not recorded' values (5.3:1 light, 6.6:1 dark on bg).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent (plotting-ink blue): nav current-page underline, solid button fill, focus ring, route arrows. Not a text colour on its own; use accent-ink for links.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Link and interactive text on bg, surface and accent-wash (9.4:1 light, 10.7:1 dark on bg).

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Hover wash for rows, routes and quiet buttons; the 'Download available' badge ground.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Reserved state colour: passed, completed, verified. Always with the ✓ glyph and a word. Text on pass-wash (5.5:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: pass-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for pass chips only.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Reserved state colour: failed, retrieval failed. Always with ✕ and a word. Text on fail-wash (5.7:1 light, 6.8:1 dark). Also the failed segment in state bars.

tokens.name: fail-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for fail chips only.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Reserved state colour: inconclusive, open runs, unresolved references, caution callouts. Always with ~ or … and a word. Text on warn-wash (5.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for warn chips, caution callouts and the draft callout.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: Reserved neutral state: not tested, excluded, planned, aborted. Dashed outline + ○ or – glyph. Text on none-wash (5.0:1 light, 5.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: none-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for not-tested / excluded chips; excluded segment fill in state bars.

tokens.name: draft
tokens.usage: Draft marking only: draft badge text/border and the hatched stripe on the draft callout. Never decorative.

tokens.name: seg-held
tokens.usage: State-bar segment for 'retrieved, held privately'. Neutral on purpose; validated against fail for normal-vision and CVD separation in both themes.

families.ui: "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
families.serif: "Source Serif 4", Charter, "Bitstream Charter", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: Research records from an astronomical data-forensics project
styles.usage: Home hero h1 only: clamp(2rem, 4.2vw, 3.1rem), max 20ch wide.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Every page's single h1 (fs-2xl; fs-xl under 640px).

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Item and sub-section headings (h3), section-title rows.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A dossier records one signal and everything done to try to explain it away.
styles.usage: One paragraph under an h1, in ink-2, max 72ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A missing match means not found in the services searched as of that date.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Figures are counted when the site is built, not streamed live.
styles.usage: Summaries, notes under tables, table body.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above titles, panel titles, dt labels (0.06em).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat-line figures only; always paired with a label and a qualifier.

styles.name: id-title
styles.usage: h1 when the title IS an identifier (candidate working IDs).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Product IDs, checksums, timestamps, paths in tables (wraps anywhere).

styles.name: chip-label
styles.usage: Badges, chips and state chips; uppercase for badges and chips, lowercase words for state chips.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: 4px — gap inside badges and chip rows, list-item spacing.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: 8px — dt/dd row gap, table cell vertical padding, nav link padding.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: 12px — table cell horizontal padding, kicker-to-title gap.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: 16px — paragraph spacing, panel stack gap, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: 24px — panel padding, desktop side gutter, page-head bottom padding.

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: 32px — main top padding, grid-2 column gap, page-head bottom margin.

tokens.name: s7
tokens.usage: 48px — space above h2 and between page sections.

tokens.name: s8
tokens.usage: 72px — main bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, buttons, inputs, callouts, focus ring corners. The system is nearly square: never round beyond this.

tokens.name: radius-tight
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, state chips, inline code, ladder rungs, step numbers (hard-coded 2px in site.css).

shadow.note: Only the focus ring. Surfaces never cast shadows.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px gap in surface, then a solid 2px accent ring (≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes).

fontSize.note: Raw size steps the stylesheet references as var(--fs-*).

tokens.name: fs-xs
tokens.usage: 12px — kickers, badges, chips, table heads, mono metadata.

tokens.name: fs-sm
tokens.usage: 13px — summaries, table body, nav links, captions, footer.

tokens.name: fs-base
tokens.usage: 16px — body copy.

tokens.name: fs-md
tokens.usage: 18px — ledes, h3, entry titles, section titles.

tokens.name: fs-xl
tokens.usage: 30px — stat figures, mono h1 (candidate IDs), h1 on phones.

tokens.name: fs-2xl
tokens.usage: 40px — serif page titles (h1).

tokens.name: lh
tokens.usage: Body line height.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of prose and ledes.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Max content width (.wrap).
